AnnexIII.description:
Annex III high-risk areas (Art. 6(2) AIA).

Values double as short locators (``III.4.a`` = Annex III point 4(a)).
``UNSURE`` is the residual case: an Annex III area is implicated but the
specific point is unsettled. The engine treats it conservatively as
high-risk and routes it to review.
AnnexIII.title: AnnexIII

AnnexISection.description:
Annex I sections for the Art. 6(1) AIA product route.

For a Section B product only Art. 6(1), Art. 60a and Arts. 102 to 112 apply,
and Arts. 57 to 59 only in so far as the high-risk requirements have been
integrated in the sectoral legislation (Art. 2(2) AIA). Regulation (EU)
2026/1744 moved machinery to Section B:
Section A, point 1 is deleted and Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 is Section B,
point 21.
AnnexISection.title: AnnexISection

Derogation.description:
Art. 6(3) AIA derogation facts for an Annex III system.

An Annex III system is *not* high-risk if it does not pose a significant
risk of harm, but only where one of the four conditions holds AND the
system does not perform profiling of natural persons. Profiling always
keeps the system high-risk (Art. 6(3), third subparagraph, AIA).
Derogation.title: Derogation

significant_change_after_application_dat.description: Art. 111(2) AIA: whether the design of a system placed on the market or put into service before its Chapter III date has changed significantly as from that date. That date is contested: the report uses the Art. 113, third paragraph, point (c) date for the route (2027-12-02 for Annex III, 2028-08-02 for Annex I), but the general date of 2026-08-02 may be meant. Null: not established.
significant_change_after_application_dat.title: Significant Change After Application Date

deployer_public_authority.description: Art. 49(3) AIA: the deployer is a public authority, Union institution, body, office or agency, or acts on behalf of one. Null: not established, so the registration of use is inferred, for review, where the system is intended to be used by public authorities or its Annex III point (5(a), 6 or 7) describes such use.
deployer_public_authority.title: Deployer Public Authority

training_flops.title: Training Flops

gpai_model_placing_on_market_date.description: Art. 111(3) AIA: the date the general-purpose AI model itself was placed on the market. Null: the model is dated by placing_on_market_date, for review.
gpai_model_placing_on_market_date.title: Gpai Model Placing On Market Date

annex_i_section.description: Annex I section of the Art. 6(1) AIA product. For Section B only the Art. 2(2) provisions apply. Null: treated as Section A.

used_for_financial_fraud_detection.description: Annex III point 5(b) AIA excepts AI systems used for the purpose of detecting financial fraud. On a III.5.b profile, true (asserted) or null (unknown) raises a review question; the system stays high-risk until it is answered.
used_for_financial_fraud_detection.title: Used For Financial Fraud Detection
